subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should OpenClaw accept these exact privileged GitHub Action revisions after the three stale workflow guard surfaces are repaired?
rationale: Third-party executable code will run with repository and publishing credentials, including a Codex wrapper whose permission-selection and internal runtime surface changed; CI can prove mechanics but cannot make this trust decision.

options.title: Repair and approve exact pins
options.body: Fix the stale assertions, refresh against main, verify exact-head checks, and have secops approve the reviewed revisions.

options.title: Split sensitive actions
options.body: Separate token-, publishing-, CodeQL-, Docker-, and Codex-bearing revisions from routine setup action updates for narrower review.

options.title: Decline the grouped batch
options.body: Close this grouped refresh and allow narrower future dependency updates if the combined acceptance boundary is too broad.

recommendation.title: Repair and approve exact pins
recommendation.body: Fix the stale assertions, refresh against main, verify exact-head checks, and have secops approve the reviewed revisions.
